ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all limited partners, general partners, ultimate beneficial owners, directors, officers and authorised signatories against: (i) United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions; (ii) UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) consolidated list; (iii) EU consolidated sanctions; (iv) Gibraltar Sanctions Act 2019 notices; and (v) US OFAC SDN list given the Apple App Store and Google Play Billing nexus. Where any individual is identified as a politically exposed person (PEP), the registered agent and ELP must apply enhanced due diligence: obtain board-level or senior management approval, establish the source of wealth and source of funds using reliable documentary evidence, and continue enhanced periodic monitoring for the duration of the relationship. Adverse media, negative news, and AML/CFT-related open-source intelligence checks are also mandatory.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Gibraltar Companies Registry (General Registry, Civil and Commercial Registry side), e-service available via HM Government of Gibraltar at https://www.gibraltar.gov.gi/finance-tax/companies-registry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All proposed names must be entered using the Latin alphabet only. English is the official procedural language. Non-English names, or names transliterated into Latin script, may be required to be accompanied by a notarised English translation or accurate transliteration in order to establish meaning and to avoid any confusion with prohibited or misleading terms. A limited partnership name must comply with the statutory suffix rules for an Exempted Limited Partnership, ordinarily ending with 'Limited Partnership' or the accepted abbreviation, and must not, in the opinion of the Registrar, be undesirable or intended to cause confusion.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a proposed name is rejected, the Registrar will issue a formal written decision noting the statutory basis for refusal. The applicant, through its Gibraltar registered agent, may within 14 days of the rejection date file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Companies enclosing full reasons and any corrective submissions. A determination on appeal is normally made within 21 business days. If the appeal is dismissed, the applicant may resubmit an amended name bearing a fresh reservation for a new 30-day window, or seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Gibraltar within 28 days of the final administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A Gibraltar Exempted Limited Partnership is required to maintain a registered office address in Gibraltar. Virtual or serviced office arrangements provided by a fully licensed corporate service provider are generally acceptable as a registered office for the ELP itself, and the entity is not required to maintain physical operational premises in Gibraltar for pre-incorporation or basic holding purposes. However, for this digital publishing business (social casino and virtual slots simulation software), banks, EMI payment processors, and platform account administrators (Apple IAP and Google Play Billing) will expect adequate commercial substance documentation, such as a physical mailing address outside simply a virtual provider, board meeting practices, accounting infrastructure, and an operational substance narrative. For Gibraltar tax residence or any future treaty claim, a more substantive physical and staff presence may be required, but virtual office is accepted at the registry stage.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate risk, quantified at approximately 20% probability within the first year of registration, with a higher likelihood if payment processing volumes increase, chargeback rates are elevated, or the GFSC receives a law enforcement or platform inquiry concerning simulated gambling products. Unannounced inspections are more likely to be directed at the licensed registered agent rather than the ELP itself, but the ELP's records must be immediately accessible in Gibraltar.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Gibraltar Limited Partnerships Act 2010 (as amended), sections 1–12 (formation and registration), section 10 (exempted status), sections 14–18 (general partner and limited partner rights); Gibraltar Companies Act 2014 where the general partner is a Gibraltar company; Financial Services (Legal Control and Beneficial Ownership) Act 2018 for beneficial ownership filing.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies House Gibraltar, Gibraltar Financial Services Commission
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form LP-1 (Application for Registration of a Limited Partnership), accompanied by the Statement of Exempted Status under section 10 of the Limited Partnerships Act 2010, together with the executed Limited Partnership Agreement and General Partner particulars.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Gibraltar Exempted Limited Partnership; no escrow or pre-paid capital requirement. The partners' agreed capital contributions are fixed in the Partnership Agreement, and limited partners' liability is confined to their unpaid agreed contribution.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) that the draft Limited Partnership Agreement tabled be approved and the General Partner is authorized to execute it in final form; (2) that the initial capital contributions of the Limited Partner(s) be accepted and recorded in the register of limited partners; (3) that the registered office of the Partnership be adopted at 57/63 Line Wall Road, Gibraltar; (4) that [Name] be appointed General Partner and [Name] be appointed Money Laundering Reporting Officer; (5) that any one signing officer be authorized to file the registration application with the Registrar of Companies, open bank accounts, and execute all ancillary documents required for the establishment of the Exempted Limited Partnership.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Registration: Name Clearance and General Partner Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Name Reservation Desk, Companies House Gibraltar, Gibraltar Financial Services Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed Exempted Limited Partnership (ELP) name together with the corporate name of the intended General Partner to the Registrar for name clearance and AML vetting. Provide the incorporation certificate and beneficial ownership snapshot of the General Partner. If cleared, the name is reserved for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation of the corporate general partner
Memorandum and articles of association of the corporate general partner
KYC/AML documentation of the general partner and initial limited partners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file an amended name incorporating the suffix 'Limited Partnership' or 'LP' within 14 days. If AML vetting raises a query, provide supplemental source-of-funds evidence or restructure beneficial ownership to satisfy regulatory comfort.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Exempted Limited Partnership
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies House Gibraltar, Gibraltar Financial Services Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and submit Form LP-1 with the Statement of Exempted Status, executed Partnership Agreement, list of partners, registered office consent, General Partner particulars and AML policy. Pay the filing fee electronically; transmit the dossier by secure portal in PDF with notarised/apostilled execution pages where required.
required_dossiers: Statement of Exempted Status under section 10 of the Limited Partnerships Act 2010
Registered office consent from a Gibraltar-licensed corporate service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query, the filing is suspended. Respond with a correction letter and re-submission within 14 days. If the objection concerns the General Partner's fitness, replace the General Partner with a Gibraltar-licensed qualifying corporate management company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue of Registration Certificate and Exempt Status Endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies House Gibraltar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues a Certificate of Registration and, where requested, a Certificate of Exempt Status under section 10. Scrutinise the certificate entries for accuracy and request endorsement amendments through the Registry's rectification procedure if any detail is inaccurate.
required_dossiers: Photo identification of signing officer or notarised power of attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate misstates the ELP's principal activity or the General Partner's name, file a rectification application supported by a statutory declaration and payment of the nominal registration amendment fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration: AML Beneficial Ownership Filing and Bank Account Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Beneficial Ownership Registry, Gibraltar Financial Services Commission; FSC-licensed Gibraltar banks
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload details of the General Partner and Limited Partners' beneficial owners to the Private Register of Beneficial Ownership within one month of registration. Complete bank account applications with FSC-licensed banks, providing the registration certificate, partnership agreement, source of wealth, passport copies, and the AML/MLRO policy.
required_dossiers: Money Laundering Reporting Officer appointment letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank declines the ELP, add a Gibraltar-licensed corporate service provider as administrator or General Partner, or provide an introduced reference banker. Withdraw and correct any incomplete beneficial ownership filing before re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Digital Business and Data Protection Notifications
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Regulatory Authority (GRA); HM Government of Gibraltar Income Tax Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Notify the GRA of the offering of simulated social casino software; no regulated gambling licence is required as no real-money wagering occurs. File the Data Protection Act 2004 notification with the GRA and complete the Business Registration Tax application with the Income Tax Office for pass-through profiling.
required_dossiers: Privacy policy and age-gating compliance statement for Apple IAP and Google Play Billing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the GRA flags the payment rails, submit an updated jurisdictional e-commerce flow chart confirming that the casual simulation space involves no real-money gambling and does not trigger the Gambling Act 2006 or remote gaming licensing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no physical manufacturing unit is established; the product is delivered remotely as software code. The sectoral counterpart for digital online activities is the Gibraltar Regulatory Authority (GRA).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating licence is required for simulated social casino publishing under Gibraltar law; only voluntary GRA data protection registration and Apple/Google developer compliance apply.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment, HM Government of Gibraltar
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — software publishing without physical premises, industrial discharge or land disturbance.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; no wastewater, VOCs or industrial waste streams are generated. Office tenancies must comply with Gibraltar's waste segregation regulations and occupational safety limits, with voluntary ISO 14001 environmental certification as best practice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Office-only occupancy clearance applies: fire safety certification under the Fire Prevention (Commercial Premises) Regulations, structural load inspections for tenanted office space, and workplace clearance under the Gibraltar Health and Safety at Work Act. Remote cloud server environments remain under the service provider's operational responsibility.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: HM Government of Gibraltar - Income Tax Office (ITO), Ministry of Finance; official portal: https://www.gibraltar.gov.gi/income-tax and associated Income Tax e-services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The ELP must be registered with the Gibraltar Income Tax Office through a recognized tax/company registration agent. For a Gibraltar-registered ELP, the agent files the registration application together with the partnership certificate, partnership deed, beneficial ownership information, registered office confirmation, and details of the general and limited partners. The ITO then assigns a Tax Reference Number (TRN). For a Cayman ELP seeking Gibraltar fiscal registration, the foreign partnership must provide its Cayman certificate of limited partnership and filing details, appoint a Gibraltar tax representative if no partner is tax-resident in Gibraltar, and apply for a Gibraltar TRN before opening a Gibraltar payment account or onboarding with Apple/Google merchant services. The procedure requires KYC documentation for all partners and confirmation of the ELP's taxable transparency status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible - The ELP is fiscally transparent for Gibraltar tax purposes; the partnership itself is not chargeable to income tax. Each partner is assessed on its respective share of partnership profits. Non-resident partners are generally within the territorial scope only in respect of income accruing in or derived from Gibraltar; capital gains and foreign-source receipt are outside the Gibraltar charge unless specifically remitted or sourced from Gibraltar.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists under Gibraltar law, and no general hybrid-mismatch election is available. The ELP is transparent by default and cannot elect to be treated as a Gibraltar-resident corporation merely by filing. The only administrative option is a reporting/collection arrangement whereby the general partner is jointly responsible for filing and payment on behalf of the partners, which does not change the pass-through classification. Any attempt to elect corporate treatment requires forming a separate Gibraltar private limited company.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT / GST / Sales and Use Tax - Gibraltar does not operate a value added tax or broad-based consumption tax; limited customs and excise duties apply to physical goods imported into Gibraltar.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - there is no turnover-based VAT/GST registration threshold in Gibraltar because no VAT/GST system is in force. Customs EORI-type registration is only required where the business physically imports into or exports from Gibraltar; this is not a revenue tax threshold and does not apply to digital social casino service provision.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance mandate applies in Gibraltar. There is no API-based tax clearance, no continuous transaction control, and no digital tax stamping for invoices. Ordinary electronic invoices, Apple/Google app-store commercial reports, and bank records are acceptable. Tax records must be retained for a minimum of six years from the end of the relevant tax year.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - Gibraltar has no VAT/GST and therefore no statutory 0% export VAT rate and no input VAT refund mechanism. Cross-border digital supplies of simulated social casino and virtual slots content via Apple IAP and Google Play Billing are outside the scope of Gibraltar indirect tax. The ELP should nonetheless maintain substance documentation and app-store payout evidence to support the treatment of foreign-source revenue in the hands of the partners.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (required only if physical media or goods are exported; N/A for pure digital app-store supply)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill (N/A for intangible services; substitute with Apple IAP and Google Play Billing transaction records)
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank SWIFT credit confirmation (retained as evidence of 180-day foreign-exchange repatriation)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Gibraltar has no VAT refund or export zero-rating clawback because no such mechanism exists. However, any false declaration to the Income Tax Office or customs authorities regarding the territorial source or dual nature of receipts may trigger civil penalties up to 100% of the tax undercharged plus statutory interest. The Income Tax Office can reopen assessments for up to six years, increasing to an unlimited period in cases of fraud or deliberate concealment. Customs-related penalties under the Customs Ordinance include fines and forfeiture where goods declarations are falsified. The ELP must maintain robust transfer-pricing and economic-substance records to withstand audit scrutiny.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of England (monetary authority for the GBP/GIP peg) and Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) as the local prudential and conduct regulator; the Government of Gibraltar issues GIP currency under the Currency Notes Act, and there is no separate Gibraltar central bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Gibraltar pound (GIP) is fully convertible to GBP at a 1:1 fixed peg with no exchange-control restrictions on current or capital account transactions. Profit remittance and capital repatriation are free, but receiving banks may require tax residence evidence and an up-to-date beneficial ownership certificate. Non-resident ELPs may hold GIP, GBP, USD and EUR multi-currency accounts; no central bank approval is required for conversion between GIP and any foreign currency.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender requirement, mandatory conversion timeline, or conversion ratio for export receipts in Gibraltar; exporters may retain 100% of foreign currency proceeds offshore, in GIP, or in any GIP/GBP current account, provided the financial institution's AML policies have been satisfied.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMI providers (e.g., Revolut Business, Stripe, and similar sponsor-bank models) will typically reject a Gibraltar non-resident ELP with no trading history and social-casino exposure. GFSC-licensed e-money institutions are permissible but require substantive local substance and full AML onboarding; even then, most EMIs decline activity classified as simulated gambling/gaming due to chargeback risk and absence of statutory licensing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At least one managing director or authorised general partner representative must attend an in-person KYC interview at the bank's Gibraltar premises before account activation. Remote video-only opening is not offered by the tier-1 Gibraltar commercial banks; a remote video interview may be accepted only after the physical interview and only for subsequent signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ELP with no demonstrated local substance in Gibraltar
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered office agreement, local secretary appointment, audited annual financial statements, detailed business plan, group structure chart, partnership deed, LEI certificate, and letters from formation agents confirming true ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Social-casino and virtual-slots activity flagged as high-risk gaming
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated legal opinion confirming simulated gameplay with no real-money redemption; platform terms showing virtual chips; payment process descriptions for Apple IAP and Google Play Billing; chargeback and fraud monitoring procedures; regulatory correspondence from a licensed payment intermediary showing no gambling licence requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial ownership of a pass-through limited partnership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Register of beneficial owners, proof of source of wealth for all limited partners, certified passport copies, address verification, source of funds declarations, and a completed control matrix identifying the general partner and each 25%+ limited partner.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be routed via SWIFT MT103 from the investing entity's bank to the Gibraltar ELP's designated operational account, referencing the facility as 'Capital Contribution - KY_ELP'. GIP banks require the beneficiary bank to hold a separate escrow or operational account, and the remitter should state purpose code 'INV' or 'General Business' where permitted by MT101/103 instruction. Pre-acceptance documentation includes the partnership deed, capital call notice, source of funds evidence, and GFSC/AML clearance certificates; no exchange control permission is required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements should be executed through SWIFT MT103 for direct vendor payments and MT700 irrevocable documentary letters of credit for high-value or inventory-based supplier contracts. GBP-denominated domestic clearing to UK beneficiaries is best routed via CHAPS through the UK agent bank; Euro payments are cleared through SWIFT via a euro correspondent as Gibraltar is not a SEPA zone member; USD payments are cleared through nostro accounts at a New York correspondent bank using SWIFT MT103.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: GBP/USD and GBP/EUR outright FX forwards
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for exposures to currencies with restricted convertibility, if any
Cross-currency swaps between GIP-linked GBP and USD/EUR for balance-sheet hedging
Vanilla FX options (plain bought puts/calls) for contingency hedging

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Gibraltar Registrar of Companies (Financial Services Commission Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 42 calendar days after the anniversary of registration; no replacement or refresh date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of GBP 50 for up to 3 months, escalating to GBP 100 for up to 6 months and GBP 500 thereafter; continued default triggers administrative strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO Beneficial Ownership Annual Confirmation Statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Beneficial Ownership Register, Gibraltar Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed on each calendar anniversary of registration; any change in beneficial ownership must be lodged within 28 days of the transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or false confirmation attracts criminal penalties up to GBP 10,000 per offence and persistent default may result in amalgamation or strike-off of the ELP.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Gibraltar Income Tax Office, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 November of each year in respect of the statutory tax year ending 30 June; return must reflect the pass-through allocation to partners.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed late filing penalty of GBP 66 per return plus accrued interest at 8% per annum on any assessed unpaid partnership liability.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit is triggered if an ELP exceeds, at any time in the preceding two consecutive financial years, two or more of the following: total turnover above GBP 10.2 million, gross assets above GBP 5.1 million, or more than 50 partners.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted for Gibraltar for statutory financial statements; Gibraltar Companies Act small-entity accounting format is available for unaudited small ELPs.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The ELP must obtain written confirmation from every partner and beneficial owner at each registration anniversary; any transfer of partnership interest must be lodged with the Registry within 28 days and reflected in the next annual UBO confirmation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 10% (resident Gibraltar companies; ELP is tax-transparent, no entity-level charge on the partnership itself)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No Gibraltar capital gains tax, no withholding tax on dividends, interest, or royalties; no VAT; unlimited loss carry-forward for trading losses; statutory exemption from therefore reduces effective taxation where profits are distributed to partners subject to their home country taxation.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (indefinite carry-forward of trading losses for Gibraltar tax purposes)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Gibraltar Partnership Tax Return (Form GP/ELP) filed through the Gibraltar Income Tax Office (GITO) e-filing portal. For ELPs with no taxable activity, an NIL return plus annual confirmation is mandatory. Partners with Gibraltar-source income file Form I.T.1 individually.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months from the end of the ELP's accounting period; for calendar-year accounting periods, no later than 31 December of the following tax year. Extension may be requested but interest accrues from statutory due date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ELP name, company number, registered office, and general partner details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Indicate jurisdiction of general partner and confirm non-resident status; for the ELP's information return, no tax payment is due at entity level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting period start and end dates; confirmation that financial statements are prepared under IFRS or UK GAAP equivalent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State whether accounting period differs from calendar year and provide corresponding year-of-assessment allocation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Breakdown of revenue by category: consumer software licensing, in-app purchase commissions, virtual currency sales, advertising.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the ELP derives Gibraltar-source revenue from digital platforms, report gross revenue and separate non-HRA charges (e.g., Apple/Google commission).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses: platform fees, marketing, staff costs, software maintenance, and royalties paid to related parties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide substantiation for related-party royalties; non-resident partners must verify arm's length nature to avoid denial of deduction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable trading profit before loss adjustment; separate non-trading income (e.g., interest).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an ELP, allocate each share of profit to every partner according to the partnership agreement. A non-resident partner's share is not automatically Gibraltar-taxable unless there is a permanent establishment or source in Gibraltar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Trading loss offset claims and carry-forward reliefs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State that losses are allocated to partners; non-resident partners should consult their domestic rules on foreign loss utilization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax ruling/disclosure regarding economic substance: number of employees in Gibraltar, physical offices, and board meeting minutes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A casual gaming ELP without local substance may trigger ESR review; provide descriptive report rather than box value.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration and signature by general partner or authorised manager.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Even for non-resident general partner, sign in authorised capacity; Gibraltar law imposes criminal liability for false declarations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of £100 initially; if continued beyond 3 months, a further daily penalty up to £150 per day (maximum £900). Incorrect returns giving rise to tax underpayment attract a sum equal to 100% of additional tax.</loc>

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Gibraltar does not levy statutory dividend withholding tax. Distributions by an ELP to partners are not subject to Gibraltar WHT, but must be disclosed to partners for home-country tax treatment.)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Gibraltar has no domestic WHT to be relieved; if partner's residence country imposes tax on dividends, the partner may claim foreign tax credit. For treaty access, the partner obtains a Gibraltar Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from the Income Tax Office (Form TRC-1) evidencing either tax residence (individual) or place of effective management (company). Submit the TRC to the foreign tax authority; where a Gibraltar withholding tax is claimed (unlikely), use the Mutual Agreement Procedure and submit the claim to GITO via Form DTA-MAP.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic rate on outbound interest and royalties is 0%. Under double taxation agreements (e.g., UK-Gibraltar DTA), interest and royalty paid to residents of treaty partners generally enjoy 0% WHT provided the beneficial owner test is met. The payer should obtain a self-declaration of beneficial ownership; receipt is not subject to Gibraltar tax. Anti-abuse provisions may recast excessive interest/royalties as distributions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File: required when the ELP's aggregated related-party transactions exceed GBP 1,000,000 in any fiscal year, or when the ELP is part of a multinational group with consolidated revenue above GBP 50,000,000. Master File and Country-by-Country Report: required for groups with consolidated revenue ≥ EUR 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Gibraltar Economic Substance (Implementation) Regulations 2019 apply to entities carrying on 'relevant activities' as defined by EU Code of Conduct Group. Publishing simulated social casino games and operating a digital platform is classified as a 'trade or business', requiring the ELP to maintain in Gibraltar: (i) core income-generating activities (CIGA) including performance of digital platform management and content creation; (ii) an adequate physical office; (iii) at least two part-time employees with decision-making responsibility; and (iv) sufficient operational expenditure proportionate to the ELP's activity. Non-compliance leads to penalties and strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately understating virtual slots gross revenue by dumping transactions into a related party's payment processor, misclassifying commissions, or using associated promoters to disguise profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Gibraltar Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2: civil penalty up to 200% of additional tax due; criminal prosecution with fines up to £5,000,000; publication of taxpayer details in the official gazette.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: General partner's directors and any shadow director can be held jointly and severally for unpaid tax plus interest; travel bans under the proceeds of Crime Act; imprisonment up to 7 years for deliberate tax evasion; disqualification as director for up to 15 years under the Companies Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the ELP solely as an invoice and bank account warehouse with no physical substance, no actual staff in Gibraltar, and board meetings conducted abroad to exploit the tax transparency and zero WHT regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the ESR Regulations 2019, a financial penalty of £5,000 for the entity and daily default penalties up to £500/day; failing to satisfy the economic substance test following an enforcement notice can lead to strike-off and dissolution; taxation at 10% on deemed profits of the ELP.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for the ESR penalty and any deemed tax if they caused the ELP to trade without substance; travel restrictions imposed by a Gibraltar court; disqualification order under Section 183 of the Companies Act 2014.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Pricing software platform licenses, marketing services, or royalties from the ELP to a related operating company at artificially low or inflated rates to shift profit out of the high-tax jurisdiction or into tax-exempt pockets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Gibraltar revenue authority applies 'small penalty' under the Transfer Pricing Rules 2018: adjustment of taxable profit; simple interest at 5% per annum; a penalty of 15% of adjusted amount if transfer pricing documentation is not prepared; in serious cases a penalty up to 100% of tax gain.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the general partner may incur civil penalties if they knowingly signed a defective transfer-pricing return; for a deliberate breach causing a tax loss to a foreign affiliate, extradition or Mutual Legal Assistance can be used; director disqualification up to 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting high-volume in-app retail and peer-to-peer betting funds from users without conducting AML/CTF customer due diligence, operating unlicensed crypto-heavy payment schemes, or using the Gibraltar bank account to receive third-party gambling proceeds without economic rationale.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Proceeds of Crime (Gibraltar) Act 2022 and the Financial Services (AML) Regulations: administrative fine up to £2,000,000 or 5% of annual turnover (whichever greater); revocation of any EMI or payment institution licence; confiscation of proceeds; criminal prosecution for money laundering with penalties of 14 years' imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The General Partner's board (especially the Money Laundering Reporting Officer) is personally criminally liable if they fail to report suspicious activity; travel bans and asset freezing orders; personal confiscation orders; dishonour-based disqualification as trustee or director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Marketing 'simulated' virtual slot machines to consumers in countries that require a gambling licence (e.g., Austria, Denmark, Poland, some US states) while failing to obtain local licensing and disguising it as a 'computer game' to avoid licence fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Not a Gibraltar tax matter, but can trigger UK and foreign licensing fines: in the UK, a break of the Gambling Act 2005 may expose the operating group to unlimited fines and censure by the Gambling Commission; in Gibraltar, despite not requiring a gaming product licence for social casino, the Commissioner can impose a public regulatory penalty of up to 10% of Gibraltar GGY if found to intermediate unlicensed remote gambling.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the Gibraltar ELP can be prosecuted in jurisdictions where customers reside; extradition possible under the Gibraltar–UK treaties; personal liability for unpaid licence fees and compensation to players; in the EU, individual cross-border penalties may pass to directors under EU anti-fraud provisions.
